question: In Statistical Estimation from Samples, how does system reliability safeguard production performance under heavy load?

options.text: By establishing deterministic resource bounds and validated constraints for statistical estimation from samples.
By computing a point estimate once from an initial sample and treating it as fixed truth thereafter, without checking whether new data would shift the estimate.
By reporting an entropy or KL-divergence value without checking whether the underlying probabilities were actually normalized to sum to one first.
By using the biased maximum-likelihood variance estimator everywhere, on the assumption that dividing by n instead of n minus 1 never matters at any sample size.

explanation: Production stability in statistical estimation from samples depends on establishing deterministic resource bounds and robust validation.
